event.title: Bounded-support ER3 elimination forces large-support macro in any polynomial-size escape
analytic_statement: If an ER3/B2 refutation pi has S lines and maximum transitive syntactic root support K_root, then pure Resolution simulates it with size at most S*2^O(K_root).

Combining this internal simulation with the frozen exponential root-Resolution lower bound yields K_root=Omega(N^eta) for at least one macro in any hypothetical polynomial-size ER3 escape on the stated hard family.
Since Delta<=log_2 N+1 in the direct parity encoding, at least one such macro has minimum NW-neighborhood cover Omega(N^eta/log N).
Therefore fixed-cover exhaustive truth-table survival cannot carry an entire polynomial-size ER3 escape.
boundaries: Provider PASS is not the analytic theorem.
The Resolution lower bound is a frozen prior result, not proved by this replay.
No unrestricted ER3 superpolynomial size lower bound is proved.
Large support does not imply large circuit/certificate size.
